Hello Marnic,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
your region regarding the following product:

Problem Description

Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 04/17/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

We analyzed the logs & found that DC1-DC1_QA21-22, COMMAND: on,
FEEDBACK: off
, BLOCKING: no, OPRSTATE: Normal (all ok), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_UNIT: 1
2024-08-18T15:30:56.856455+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [SCO] OGC[1]: DC2-DC2_QA13-14, COMMAND: on,
FEEDBACK: off,
BLOCKING: yes, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(off FBK while on), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_UNIT: 2
For this issue we have the following steps:
Check the Coil
:
Supply voltage separately to the coils (QA13-14 and QA21-22). (Disconnect the supply from panel source and use external 24v across the coil A2.)
Observe if they pick up properly.
Evaluate Contactor Condition
:
If the coils are not picking up properly when voltage is supplied, the contactors might be faulty.
Check Auxiliary Contactors
:
If the coils pick up properly, the next step is to check the auxiliary contactors.
Ensure these are functioning correctly as they control the main DC output for charging.
Verify Feedback to PLC
:
Check the feedback mechanism that provides the status to the PLC.
Ensure that the feedback signals are accurate and correctly interpreted by the PLC.
Please ensure all steps are followed meticulously to resolve the identified issues.
Step-2
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Beerpal Singh
